name: Adaspace Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Adaspace Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells artificial intelligence (AI) satellites and satellite-based solutions in China. The company offers AI application satellites equipped with AI payloads for onboard data analysis, computing, remote sensing, and autonomous in-orbit decision-making, as well as AI computing satellites that provide AI-driven data analysis and computing services for other spacecraft and ground-based applications. It also manufactures and sells satellite structural components, satellite materials and models for research and educational purposes, and provides satellite-related branding and naming services.
